var maxEqualFreq = function(nums) {
  const n = nums.length;
  const count = new Int32Array(100001); // or n+1? nums[i] up to 1e5.
  const freq = new Int32Array(n + 2); // number of values with frequency f
  let distinct = 0;
  let maxF = 0;
  let ans = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const x = nums[i];
    const old = count[x];
    if (old === 0) distinct++;
    else freq[old]--;
    const nw = old + 1;
    count[x] = nw;
    freq[nw]++;
    if (nw > maxF) maxF = nw;
    const L = i + 1;
    let valid = false;
    if (maxF === 1) {
      valid = true;
    } else {
      // condition 2
      if (freq[maxF] === 1 && L - maxF === (distinct - 1) * (maxF - 1)) {
        valid = true;
      } else if (maxF > 1 && freq[1] === 1 && L - 1 === (distinct - 1) * maxF) {
        valid = true;
      }
    }
    if (valid) ans = L;
  }
  return ans;
};
